This [[town]] is actually underground so only the [[mission map]] shows the layout of this location. {{Quotation|game| Carved as a shrine to [[Melandru]] in ancient times, this red-rocked vault was once used as cistern by the [[Kournan]]s to contain [[the Elon]]'s floodwaters. When that enterprise failed, the sanctuary was walled off and forgotten, inhabited only by things that like to live in the dark. Now it serves as a secret refuge for the [[Sunspears]]. }} ==Getting there== The [[primary quest]] [[Hunted!]], obtained from [[Sunspear Modiki]] after completion of the [[Consulate Docks]] mission, will eventually end in this location, after the [[Secure the Refuge]] [[mini-mission]]. ==Exits== *[[Command Post]] (north) *[[Marga Coast]] (south) ==Quests available== *[[Lonai]] **[[The Great Escape]] {{quest icon|primary}} **[[The Command Post]] **[[And a Hero Shall Lead Them]] {{quest icon|primary}} **[[Centaur Blackmail]] {{quest icon|primary}} **[[Mysterious Message (Nightfall quest)|Mysterious Message]] {{quest icon|primary}} **[[Crossing the Desolation]] {{quest icon|primary}} ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 20 [[Perdahn]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 20 [[Turshi]] (merchant) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) =====Henchmen===== :''(all level 20)'' *{{w}} [[Devona]] (Fighter) *{{r}} [[Aidan]] (Archer) *{{mo}} [[Kihm]] (Healer) *{{mo}} [[Mhenlo]] (Healer) *{{n}} [[Eve]] (Blood) *{{me}} [[Odurra]] (Illusion) *{{e}} [[Cynn]] (Fire) *{{e}} [[Herta]] (Earth) *{{p}} [[Sogolon]] (Motivation) *{{d}} [[Gehraz]] (Holy) ====Other allies==== *{{n}} 20 [[Lonai]] *{{x}} 20 [[Scout Kahra]] ==Notes== {{gw2w|Sun's Refuge|3=}} *Compared to other [[:Category:Towns|towns]], the Sunspear Sanctuary offers very little [[NPC service]]s. Most of them are only found in the [[Command Post]] [[explorable area]] outside this town. *Next to Lonai is what is believed to be a [[Forgotten]] pillar normally seen only in the [[Crystal Desert]] and the [[Lair of the Forgotten]]. *Just inside the exit to the [[Marga Coast]], there appears to be a [[resurrection shrine]] through the portal. Upon using that portal, the shrine seems to have disappeared.
